walkthroughs.body_html:
Everything that begins to exist has a cause.

Thomas Aquinas argued: an infinite chain of causes is impossible, so there must be an uncaused first cause — and this is God.

Without God, where did the universe come from?

The world looks designed — eyes, ecosystems, the precise laws of physics.

William Paley (1802): if you found a watch on a heath, you'd know it had a watchmaker. The world is far more complex, so it must have a Designer — God.

Modern versions point to the 'fine-tuning' of the universe.

Atheist objections:

Cosmological: 'Who caused God?' Or — maybe the universe just is (like physics suggests).

Design: David Hume said the world has flaws (suffering, disease) — a poor designer? Charles Darwin's evolution can explain order without a Designer.

Believers reply: God is by definition uncaused; design still needs explaining at the fundamental laws level.

mcqs.q: What is the doctrine of the Trinity?
options: God is one being existing in three persons (Father, Son, Holy Spirit) — distinct in person but united in essence; Christians remain monotheistic.
Christians believe in three different gods.
The Quran was written by Allah and dropped from heaven.
The Trinity refers to heaven, earth and hell.

mcqs.q: How do Muslims believe the Quran was revealed?
options: Muhammad wrote the Quran based on his own teachings.
The Trinity refers to heaven, earth and hell.
Through the angel Jibril (Gabriel) to Muhammad over 23 years; Muslims believe it is the literal word of God, not Muhammad's own words.
The Quran was written by Allah and dropped from heaven.

mcqs.q: What do orthodox Christians believe about the nature of Jesus?
options: Jesus was half God and half human.
He is fully God and fully human at the same time (the incarnation) — both natures united in one person, as defined at the Council of Chalcedon.
Jesus was a human who became God after his resurrection.
The Quran was written by Allah and dropped from heaven.
